title: malva caroliniana var. decumbens
intro: Malva caroliniana var. decumbens, commonly known as prostrate mallow, is a plant species in the mallow family (Malvaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of prostrate mallow are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and demulcent properties. The bioactive constituents of Malva caroliniana var. decumbens include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
